Thought: Perfect! The molecular formula C10H14 corresponds to a mass of 134, which matches our mass spectrometry data. The structure also explains all our spectroscopic observations:
1. Mass spec shows M+ = 134.11 (matches C10H14)
2. IR shows aromatic C-H stretches (3045-3031 cm-1) and aliphatic C-H stretches (2990-2927 cm-1)
3. The structure contains both aromatic ring and aliphatic chain, consistent with all data
Final Answer: CCCCc1ccccc1
